$comment: One-way sync: hub (AgentArmy) -> spoke repos. Hub is the source of truth for the multi-coder agent helper surface (Claude Code + OpenAI Codex + Gemini Antigravity). This is the 'dressing' routine: it makes a bare spoke a fully-dressed AgentArmy template for every supported agentic coder. EASY TO ADD TO AND RUN: add a repo to `spokes`, add a file/dir to `paths`, then `python scripts/sync_helpers_to_spokes.py`. `deny` is a hard safety net enforced even if a path is added by mistake. See docs/spoke-sync.md.
$pack_note: `paths` is grouped by coder: shared (AGENTS.md + CONSTITUTION.md), Claude Code (.claude/*), OpenAI Codex (.codex/* — AGENTS.md is also Codex's primary instruction file), Gemini Antigravity (.agents/plugins). The two sync_agents_to_* scripts ride along so a spoke can regenerate its Codex/Antigravity packs from .claude/agents/categories/, and .codex/hooks.json stays self-consistent. To dress for a NEW coder: add its pack dir(s) here under a new group.
$automation_note: The PR-event workflows (claude.yml, copilot-review.yml, review-loop.yml) are HUB-AUTHORITATIVE and synced so every spoke runs the same review automation; they are portable (use ${{ github.repository }} / ${{ github.repository_owner }}), so the hub version works verbatim in any spoke. notify-hub*.yml report a spoke's PR artifacts back to the hub. These are file-present checks in the fleet heartbeat (pr-subscription-missing); the workflows still need each spoke's own secrets set to FUNCTION (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, PROJECT_TOKEN, and optional LOCAL_FLEET_MCP_URL / CF_ACCESS_* for fleet MCP).
$ownership_note: templates/arcadedb-image (and future templates/*-image/ platform images: fuseki, event-bridge, …) are intentionally NOT synced — they're hub-owned platform infra per ARC-ADR-023. Spokes consume the running instances via env (ARCADEDB_URL, NATS_URL, …), not by vendoring the Dockerfile.
